text: “It won’t be much use, but I shall try. I certainly would rather have you easily than have to fight for you.” “Don’t talk about fighting; we shall not fight.” “Ah, we must be prepared,” Morris rejoined; “you especially, because for you it must come hardest. Do you know the first thing your father will say to you?” “No, Morris; please tell me.” “He will tell you I am mercenary.” “Mercenary?” “It’s a big word; but it means a low thing. It means that I am after your money.” “Oh!” murmured Catherine softly. The exclamation was so deprecating and touching that Morris indulged in another little demonstration of affection.
